rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically slanted rather than upright or perpendicular.

example.english: The plank is oblique, so you can't use it as a staircase.
example.traditional: 塊木板斜住擺，唔可以當樓梯用。
example.jyutping: faai3 muk6 baan2 ce3 zyu6 baai2 m4 ho2 ji5 dong3 lau4 tai1 jung6

rows.note: Use this when someone communicates indirectly or avoids stating something plainly.

example.english: If you have any complaints, say them directly instead of being oblique.
example.traditional: 有咩不滿就直講啦，唔好拐彎抹角。
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 bat1 mun5 zau6 zik6 gong2 laa1 m4 hou2 gwaai2 waan1 mut3 gok3

rows.note: Use this for an indirect link, method, or effect, rather than roundabout wording in conversation.

example.english: I learned about it through an oblique route, not directly from them.
example.traditional: 我係間接知道件事嘅，唔係佢親口講畀我聽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 gaan3 zip3 zi1 dou6 gin6 si6 ge3 m4 hai6 keoi5 can1 hau2 gong2 bei2 ngo5 teng1
